verdict.rationale: Granola documents bot-free capture from device audio ('Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot'), and it works across Zoom, Meet, Teams and other meeting apps, which covers the core of the story. However, its own transparency docs say it posts a message in the meeting chat when transcription starts, so external participants may see something extra; whether this is optional is undocumented. Missing for 10: evidence that the chat notification can be turned off so participants truly see nothing, and independent or hands-on confirmation of bot-free capture.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot
Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and every other meeting app.
It can transcribe meetings (Zoom, Meet, Teams, etc.), in-person conversations, voice memos, and any computer audio.
